home.pitch: I research distributed systems reliability. My work asks how systems can keep their promises when parts of them fail.
about: I am a doctoral candidate at the [Chair of Example Systems](https://www.example-university.example/example-systems/) at Example University, working on distributed systems reliability: how large systems detect failures and keep agreeing on state.
Before the doctorate I worked as a research assistant at the Example Research Institute, where I built testbeds for consensus protocols under injected faults.
